source: Siedem dni do Renu, the Warsaw Pact exercise plan of 1979, declassified by the Polish Ministry of National Defence in November 2005; the cities are those named in the reporting of the release. The primary document is public in Poland and is not transcribed here
forceSource: Cochran, Arkin and Hoenig, Nuclear Weapons Databook; Norris and Kristensen, Nuclear Notebook, for the theatre systems of 1979
note: The plan assumes NATO uses nuclear weapons first, on Poland, and answers westward. Both halves are drawn. The western cities are named in the release; the Polish cities are the country's largest of the period and stand for a premise the plan states without a transcribed list.
